budget_clock_definition: 2000 is a cumulative fitting-budget coordinate; one coordinate permits up to two D epochs. An action may consume multiple coordinates. It is not 2000 required communication events, and M=48 does not allocate periodic time slots.
block_definition: Configuration/receiving blocks cap at 32/16 epochs, charged to the cumulative 1000-epoch stage allowance; nominal 4000/client and 16000/fleet are upper bounds, not executed counts.
